title: Fast Attest Onramp: checklist & evaluation notes
summary: Working draft: lightweight attestation onramp for customer-managed networks. Focus on a minimal evidence capsule and approval checkpoints suitable for early pilots. Emphasis on low-bandwidth evidence, signed receipts, and sampling heuristics to reduce storage cost while preserving auditability.
problem_statement: Customers onboarding private deployments need an easy, low-friction way to provide verifiable proof that network changes and connectivity handshakes occurred. Current PRDs are heavy on full-retention audit streams; we need a middle path for SMB/scale pilots: compact, signed attestations + sampling that satisfy security reviews without incurring large archive costs.
goals: 1) Define a minimal evidence capsule customers can produce during VPC handshakes. 2) Design approval gate steps for self-service and operator-assisted flows. 3) Specify an audit log retention/sampling policy that balances forensics and cost. 4) Create acceptance criteria + rollout plan for a pilot with 3 customers.
success_metrics:
- Pilot onboarding time reduction (goal: <= 3 business days)
- Average audit storage per customer <= 150MB/month during pilot
- 90% of onboarding cases pass automated checks without escalation
- Investigator reproduction rate: ability to rehydrate event sequence for sampled cases >= 95%
user_stories:
- As a network operator I want a short checklist to attach to onboarding so I can hand over to security reviewers.
- As a SRE I want signed change receipts so I can correlate operator actions to customer-side events.
- As a security reviewer I want periodic sampled packets-of-proof for high-risk changes.
requirements:
MUST: produce a compact evidence capsule (JSON blob <= 64KB) for each VPC handoff that contains (canonical proof metadata, timestamp, non-repudiation signature).
MUST: evidence capsules can be anchored by customer KMS signatures or HSM-derived attestation tokens.
MUST: provide an automated preflight verifier that checks reachability, expected CIDR mappings, and key validity.
MUST: store full audit stream for 7 days; sampled expansions for 90/365-day windows.
SHOULD: allow customers to opt into longer retention (enterprise add-on).
MAY: include optional packet-capture snapshot attachments for high-risk changes (size limited).
audit_log_schema_notes:
- capsule_id: short GUID string
- timestamp_utc: ISO8601
- actor_type: operator | customer | system
- actor_id: username or service-account
- action: vpc:handshake | vpc:update | firewall:change
- metadata: flat k/v list (max 12 entries)
- signature: base64 of customer-signed digest
- anchor_refs: list of immutable evidence refs (optional)
Notes: keep metadata flat to simplify search. Avoid embedding full diffs inside capsule; reference diff blob by id.
approval_gate_flow:
- Gate A (automated): preflight verifier + signature present? PASS -> proceed. FAIL -> Gate B.
- Gate B (operator-assist): solutions eng reviews evidence capsule and runs guided checklist (reachability, DNS, expected ASNs). If minor mismatch -> remediation; if major -> escalate to Gate C.
- Gate C (customer legal/security sign-off): required for jurisdictional/regulated customers or changes flagged by heuristics (e.g., new egress to unknown ASN).
- Fallbacks: if Gate B unavailable, allow a time-bounded auto-rollback and require post-hoc attestation within 24 hours.
failure_modes_and_mitigation:
- Missing signature: block handshake and provide in-UI remediation steps.
- Capsule too large: reject and return guidance to trim attachments or use ref blobs.
- KMS-unavailable: support soft-fallback to short-lived signed ephemeral token from Redwood with audit mark and customer acknowledgement.
- Storage billing spike: automatic sampling throttle and alert to account owner.
data_retention_and_sampling:
- Full raw stream retained for 7 days.
- Evidence capsule archived for 90 days by default; selected high-risk capsules retained 365 days.
- Sampling rules: retain 100% of changes labeled high-risk (heuristics: external-egress, infra-scope expansion, exec-flag), 10% of medium-risk, 1% of low-risk.
- Admin can request on-demand expansion for a capsule (pull full raw logs for a window) within retention window.
security_and_cryptography_notes:
- Prefer customer-managed KMS for signing; support RSA/ECDSA.
- Signed digest algorithm: SHA-256 with clear canonicalization rules.
- Signed receipts should include nonce + timestamp to mitigate replay.
- All telemetry transmitted over mTLS; receipts stored encrypted-at-rest with per-tenant keys.
observability_and_queries:
- Expose per-capsule indexing: capsule_id, customer_id, risk_label, gate_status, actor_id, created_at.
- Console view: onboarding timeline, quick-replay link for sampled capsules, and evidence export.
- Provide prebuilt BigQuery/ES ingestion mapping + sample queries for compliance teams.
rollout_plan:
1) Internal alpha: 2 weeks with SRE + Solutions Eng using synthetic customers.
2) Pilot cohort: onboard 3 customers (diverse regulatory profiles) over 6 weeks.
3) Gather metrics + security signoff; iterate sampling heuristics.
4) Beta: expose opt-in to self-serve onramp in console.
5) GA: include in private-deployments onboarding with enterprise retention add-on pricing.
acceptance_criteria:
- Automated preflight passes in >= 90% of pilot onboarding attempts.
- Evidence capsule format validated by legal/security for two pilot customers.
- No P0 security incidents from pilot.
- Tooling to request capsule expansion works end-to-end.
open_questions:
- How strict should the canonical metadata schema be to support future forensic needs? (flexible vs prescriptive)
- Should offline/off-network customers be allowed to upload signed capsules manually? implications for authenticity.
- What's the pricing model for longer retention and on-demand expansions?
- Do we require Redwood-hosted attestation fallback to be audited by third party?

notes: Informal brain-dump: prefer pragmatic over perfect for pilot. Keep UI friction low: show a single status card and link to evidence download. Include a small ‘notes to reviewer’ field in capsule for operators to explain anomalies. Will iterate if legal asks for additional fields.
